incident-bot: INCIDENT 1765239873 - High 5xx and gateway timeouts on api.redwood.ai — paging :rotating_light:
incident-bot: detected at 07:03 UTC, endpoints hit: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings; error mix: 502, 504, upstream-reset; approx 20% of traffic failed
jason: I got the pager. Starting root cause checklist. Pulling envoy stats.
jason: `curl -s http://lb-admin.internal/stats | grep -E "upstream_rq_5xx|cluster_manager"` -> clusters show upstream_rq_5xx spikes across api-primary and api-secondary
nina: I rolled a LB tweak PR earlier today to lower connection limits and increase retries (PR #2441). It rolled at 06:58. Could be related.
opsbot: Change detected: envconfig:2026-03-11T06:58:10Z by nina (PR #2441). Rollout target: envoy-lb-prod.
deploy-bot: Roll r-2441 completed 06:58:45, status: successful.
jason: Hypothesis: decreased max_connections caused queueing then retries multiplied requests -> overload and 5xx. I'll disable retries for affected routes and revert connection caps.
support: CS reports multiple customers seeing "504 Gateway Timeout" and retry loops. Support opened tickets and posted initial status update.
jason: Applying hotfix: disable retry_policy on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings on one canary zone:
```
POST http://lb-admin.internal/v1/config
{
  "patch": [
    {"op":"replace","path":"/routes/generate/retry_policy","value":null},
    {"op":"replace","path":"/routes/embeddings/retry_policy","value":null}
  ]
}
```
jason: Canary (zone-east) shows error rate dropping from 20% -> 6% within 90s.
opsbot: Scaling envoy-lb-prod +3 instances as temporary headroom.
jason: After rolling revert of connection limit (max_connections back to 1200) and removing retries globally, 5xx fell to ~0.9% cluster-wide by 07:25.
nina: Reverting PR #2441 now and creating a follow-up with safer defaults + stress test plan.
oncall-sre: Taking handoff at 07:30 UTC. jason please summarize outstanding risks.
jason: Summary: immediate mitigations done (retries disabled, connection limits restored, extra LB instances). Error rates stable <1%. Risks: if upstream pods still saturating, we may see residual 502s; need to confirm no lingering retry budget causing client-side duplicate requests. Follow-ups: postmortem, gating for config changes (load test), retry-budget implementation, charting retry amplification metric.
infra-eng: Recommend adding pre-deploy canary check that simulates sustained connections to ensure circuit_breakers aren't set below safe thresholds.
support: Posted detailed customer impact: affected window 06:58-07:25 UTC, ~32k failed requests, more severe for low-traffic customers making large batch embedding calls.
incident-bot: Incident 1765239873 — mitigated. Severity lowered to SEV-2. Please attach postmortem and action items to INC-2026-372.
oncall-sre: I'll own the postmortem. Tagging @infra-eng @platform for action items and @support for customer comms.
